subject: ss-medical-oncology
title: Monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates: mechanisms of action, payload kinetics and targeted delivery

steps.tx: Naked therapeutic monoclonal antibodies exert anti-neoplastic activity through complex immunological and receptor-blocking mechanisms. Functional mechanisms comprise direct receptor antagonism, complement-dependent cytotoxicity CDC, and antibody-dependent cellular phagocytosis ADCP. Crucially, **antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity** ADCC is mediated when the antibody Fc region binds to **CD16 receptors** on circulating natural killer cells, triggering targeted exocytosis of perforin and granzymes directly into malignant cells.
steps.say: Naked therapeutic monoclonal antibodies exert anti-neoplastic activity through complex immunological and receptor-blocking mechanisms. Functional mechanisms comprise direct receptor antagonism, complement-dependent cytotoxicity, and phagocytosis. Crucially, antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity ADCC is mediated when the antibody Fc region binds to CD16 receptors on natural killer cells, triggering exocytosis of perforin and granzymes.

nodes.label: Fc Domain Engages CD16 on NK Cells

steps.tx: Antibody-drug conjugates represent tripartite molecular therapeutics engineered for selective cytotoxic payload delivery. An **antibody-drug conjugate** ADC consists of a high-affinity humanized monoclonal antibody, a stable synthetic chemical linker, and a potent cytotoxic **small molecule payload**. Typical payloads include auristatin or maytansinoid microtubule disruptors and camptothecin topoisomerase I inhibitors, which are far too toxic for unencapsulated systemic intravenous administration.

right.title: Naked Monoclonal Antibody
points: Relies on receptor blockade and host immunity
Resistance via alternative downstream pathway bypass

steps.tx: Intracellular cytotoxic delivery occurs through receptor-mediated endocytosis followed by endolysosomal routing. Binding of the conjugate to its cell-surface antigen promotes clathrin-dependent **endocytosis and lysosomal** trafficking. Within the acidic, protease-rich lysosome, proteolytic cleavage of valine-citrulline linkers by **cathepsin B** or complete lysosomal degradation of non-cleavable linkers liberates free active cytotoxic payload directly into the target cytosol, inducing irreversible mitotic arrest or DNA damage.

steps.tx: ADC potency across heterogeneous solid tumours is greatly augmented by the diffusion of released cytotoxic molecules. The **bystander effect** occurs when membrane-permeable, uncharged released payloads diffuse across cell membranes out of antigen-positive cells to eradicate adjacent **antigen-negative tumour cells**. This critical pharmacodynamic property overcomes intratumoural target heterogeneity, as demonstrated by the profound efficacy of trastuzumab deruxtecan in HER2-low metastatic breast malignancies.

left.title: Cleavable Linker (Bystander +)
points: Diffuses to kill adjacent antigen-negative cells

steps.tx: Targeting CD30 in classical lymphoid malignancies validates the ADC therapeutic paradigm. **Brentuximab vedotin** couples a chimeric anti-CD30 IgG1 monoclonal antibody to the synthetic tubulin-disrupting toxin **monomethyl auristatin E** MMAE via a protease-cleavable valine-citrulline dipeptide linker. Approved for classical Hodgkin lymphoma and systemic anaplastic large cell lymphoma, its most frequent dose-limiting toxicities are peripheral sensory neuropathy and neutropenia.

rows: Metastatic HER2+ and HER2-low breast cancer

steps.tx: Evolution of anti-HER2 ADCs represents a major clinical and pharmacological breakthrough in solid oncology. **Trastuzumab deruxtecan** T-DXd features a topoisomerase I inhibitor exatecan derivative payload with an exceptionally high **drug-to-antibody ratio** DAR of approximately 8:1. Coupling this potent payload via a cleavable tetrapeptide linker generates powerful bystander tumour killing, revolutionizing outcomes in DESTINY-Breast03 and DESTINY-Breast04 trials for both HER2-positive and HER2-low cancers.

steps.tx: Trophoblast cell-surface antigen 2 directed therapy addresses refractory epithelial cancers. **Sacituzumab govitecan** is an ADC directing the active irinotecan metabolite **SN-38** against TROP-2 via a proprietary hydrolysable pH-sensitive linker. Demonstrating substantial overall survival gains in the ASCENT and TROPiCS-02 randomized clinical trials, sacituzumab govitecan is approved for pre-treated metastatic triple-negative breast cancer and hormone receptor-positive HER2-negative metastatic breast carcinoma.

steps.tx: Advanced urothelial carcinoma displays near-universal cell-surface expression of adhesion molecules. **Enfortumab vedotin** targets **Nectin-4**, an immunoglobulin-like adhesion protein abundant in bladder carcinoma, delivering monomethyl auristatin E. When combined with the PD-1 inhibitor pembrolizumab in the EV-302 phase 3 trial, enfortumab vedotin doubled overall survival compared to platinum-based chemotherapy, establishing a new first-line global standard of care in metastatic urothelial cancer.
